predicates.name: No Requirements
predicates.notes: For situations where a traversal has no restrictions.

predicates.name: Invalid
predicates.notes: For situations where a traversal can never happen.
predicates.aliases: invalid, impassable, can miss, you have literally no reason to ever do this

predicates.name: Prerequisite Check
predicates.notes: Use when another check (in the same room or another room) is the gatekeeper for a condition. Review the special {check} syntax in the syntax guide.
predicates.aliases: prereq, complete, defeat, activate, unlock, clear, after

predicates.name: Have Item
predicates.notes: Use when ownership of an item is enough, even if you can't equip/use it.

predicates.name: Get
predicates.notes: Used to represent an absolute number of the required countable to meet the requirement.

predicates.name: Spend
predicates.notes: Used in situations where the resource is consumed instead of permanently gained, and therefore requirements need to be based on cumulative counts instead of absolute counts.

predicates.name: Needle Attack
predicates.notes: Basic directional attacks with the needle. Can optionally specify crests.

predicates.name: Longclaw Attack
predicates.notes: Basic directional attacks with the needle enhanced with longclaw distance. Can optionally specify crests.

predicates.name: Break Silk Blockade
predicates.notes: Known silk blockade breakers: defeating bell beast, silk spear, sharpdart, rune rage, weaver silkshot, pimpillo, and needle strikes from hunter, reaper, beast, or shaman.
predicates.aliases: break silk blockade, clear silk blockade

predicates.name: Break Vines
predicates.notes: Use when you need to break vines or cut rope. Needed for attack randomization.

predicates.name: Break Wall
predicates.notes: Use when you need to break a wall. Needed for attack randomization.

predicates.name: Break Blast Rock
predicates.notes: Use when you need to trigger a blast rock. Needed for attack randomization.

predicates.name: Open Airlock
predicates.notes: Use when you need to flip an airlock switch. Needed for attack randomization. (Airlocks are the doors that open and close behind you in Deep Docks after you flip the lever.)
predicates.aliases: open airlock, break airlock, hit airlock

predicates.name: Flip Switch
predicates.notes: Use when you need to interact with a switch. Needed for attack randomization.
predicates.aliases: flip switch, flip lever, break switch, break lever, hit switch, hit lever

predicates.name: Think
predicates.notes: Pass the tutorial (upgrading both your apworld and randomizer version to match) to unlock this capability.

predicates.name: Taunt
predicates.aliases: taunt, garama, shaw, adino, git gud, hegale

Implies having the tool, being able to equip it, and access to refills. This should not be controlled by enhanced movement settings, as this is a core part of game logic.

predicates.notes: This implies you have the tool and the tool slot to equip it.

predicates.name: Shredding Damage
predicates.notes: Implies having and the ability to equip Sawtooth Circlet, Cogwork Wheel, Delver's Drill, Conchcutter, Beast Crest, or Architect Crest.

predicates.name: Skewering Damage
predicates.notes:
Implies having and being able to equip Sting Shard or Longpin. 
*Needle Phial also causes skewering damage, but should not be factored into logic because it is lost when upgrading to Plasmium Phial.

predicates.name: Searing Damage
predicates.notes: Implies having and being able to equip Flintslate, Pimpillo, Wispfire Lantern, or Voltvessels.

predicates.name: Drill Crystal Pogo
predicates.notes: Implies owning tools delver's drill and memory crystal and being able to equip them both at the same time. Involves taking damage to create the crystal and then using the drill to gain vertical height from it.

predicates.name: Hazard Respawn
predicates.notes: Indicates the user takes advantage of a hazard respawn to cross a gap. Must be careful not to confuse with damage boost, which does not respawn the player. Quantity indicates masks of damage taken.

predicates.name: Damage Boost
predicates.notes: Indicates the user takes advantage of a taking damage to cross a gap. Must be careful not to confuse with hazard respawn, which respawns the player. Quantity indicates masks of damage taken.

predicates.name: Proficient Movement
predicates.notes: For situations that do not use a specific stall or skip technique, but the traversal requires a minimum skill level.

predicates.name: Craw Summons Ready
predicates.notes:
Ready to receive Craw Summons at an eligible bench spot. Created a predicate because there is not a singular spot to define the logic. Implies proper story progression, but not eligible bench access. Bench access logic is applied by using this requirement on the check location.

"To receive the Craw Summons, Hornet must have reached Act 3, completed the SEEK: Awaiting the End objective, and hit the lever inside the Craw house on Craw Lake." - per the wiki
